items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; conditional for the six zero-spend, reversible routing-only repairs. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security site facts are unknown across 61 managed sites; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, dependency provenance, release controls, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance reports 36 passes, 19 fails, and 6 unknowns. No credential exposure or exploit is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not clearance. Exact decision: retain only the six metadata-only routing repairs for 0daynews.com, arttogogh.com, eastcoastrappers.com, reviewtattoo.com, ultrarough.com, and weirdassstuff.com, conditional on exact installed-owner alignment, canonical-task cleanliness, no duplication, focused validation, and rollback metadata. Do not treat routing acceptance as security clearance, production readiness, go-live approval, or delivery. Block public launch, production deployment, credential or configuration changes, dependency additions, telemetry activation, and security-sensitive exposure until the evidence matrix is complete. Severity: high for fleet-wide release/security admission uncertainty; low for the scoped routing metadata changes.
